newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: JCI sees 15 pct profit decline for 96/97.
newsitem.headline: JCI sees 15 pct profit decline for 96/97.

text.p: South African mining giant JCI Ltd said on Wednesday that profits for 1996/97 would decline by about 15 percent on the previous year.
"In the '97 finnacial year ended June profit will decline by some 15 percent," Rob Still, JCI's head of business development, told the Diggers and Dealers mining conference here.
He did not elaborate in his presentation but he later told Reuters the decline was due in part to depressed chrome prices during the year.
Still said the full year results are due to be released in a few weeks, in August.
In the year ended June 30, 1996, JCI's headline earnings rose to 349 million rand from 266 million a year earlier.
Chrome accounted for 76 million rand of the total, up from 32 million in 1994/95.
